full_name: Paul Ginsparg | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Paul Ginsparg, a professor of physics and of computing and information science at Cornell University, has recently applied a variety of computer science and physics-based approaches to questions of aggregation and navigation of networked scholarly resources.
